general.notes: Copper RJ-45 transceiver (not optical). Cable reach stated as 100 m (Cat 6a); schema reach_km not populated. Data rate in Table 5 given as 1000–2500 Mb/sec (IEEE 802.3 compatible). Power: Features state max 2.5 W; Table 1 notes 1.2 W max over full voltage/temperature range; supply current max 375 mA. Electrical power section text mentions +5 V +/- 5% while Table 1 defines Vcc 3.13–3.47 V (+3.3 V interface). LOS described relative to receiver sensitivity per standard in use; no optical LOS thresholds in dBm. Caution: power consumption and surge current higher than SFP MSA values.
general.suggestions: Add copper media types (Cat 5e, Cat 6a) and RJ-45 to connector_type; add SFP/SFP+ to form_factor; add cable_reach_m for non-fiber modules; clarify bit_rate field when source uses Mb/sec vs Gb/s without conversion.
